note: Step 7 speculative fixture (derivation A): every expect and until is derived by hand from the 39-wire topology and the p.44 rule, not printed. No erratum touches this program. The free-ended 6E/free* line is script cord 39 on 6E#2 (6E#1 holds 5E/6E); goals use D5#2, D3#2, D7#2 (hole #1 holds 4L/D5, 3H/D3, 4H/D7). Topology: the motor sits permanently on RUN (D17/M+, D18/M-) and stops only when D19 is shorted to minus, through relay 6 N.O. 6G (arm 6H on minus via pushbutton 5 N.C.) or through pushbutton 6 N.C. 6Z (arm 6Y on D1, minus only with the wiper on 1). Relays 5 and 6 (parallel coils) pull in only while the wiper rests on the goal contact. Relay 2 is the memory: set by relay 5, latched through 2K, cleared by pushbutton 4. Relays 3 and 4 (parallel coils) are on when relay 2 is on and relay 6 is out; they blank the path lights 5, 4, 3 (on D3, D5, D7) and light light 1 through the D2-D4-D6-D8 chain. The circuit remembers that a goal was found, not which contact: the goal itself stays the wire. Derived, not printed: removing the goal wire while the dial rests on the goal sends the dial back to 1 by itself (the 6G STOP short opens). Script choices, not printed: goal order D5, D3, D7; pushbutton 6 and 5 held until the dial reaches its target; 3000 ms rests after each until. Rest positions depend on the wiper stopping on the pad with no coast overrun (O-R5, O-R13, O-R14; phase-5-step7-notes V-MAZESOLVER).
